topic: Build a middleware pipeline system across 6 files. Create middleware/pipeline.js (Pipeline class that chains middleware functions), create middleware/auth.js (checks req.headers.token), create middleware/ratelimit.js (tracks requests per IP, blocks after limit), create middleware/transform.js (converts req.body to uppercase), wire everything in middleware/index.js (exports createPipeline factory that assembles auth->ratelimit->transform chain), and modify server.js to use the pipeline. Study server.js to understand the request/response pattern. Run "node test/middleware.test.js". When tests pass, call finish.
